title: Waymo to Launch Tokyo Robotaxi Service Using Toyota bZ4X
excerpt: Waymo plans to launch a robotaxi service in Tokyo in 2027 using purpose-built Toyota bZ4X electric vehicles assembled in Japan.
body_html:
Waymo has revealed plans to use Toyota bZ4X electric vehicles for its upcoming robotaxi service in Tokyo, scheduled to launch in 2027. These vehicles will be assembled in Japan.

The announcement follows a strategic partnership between Waymo and Toyota that was initially established in April 2025. According to the details provided, the electric robotaxis will be manufactured completely under one roof at a Toyota facility.
